_schema.purpose: Pin the room-key derivation (roomSecret -> roomId + 5 subkeys) so Rust and TS implementations agree byte-for-byte.

format.version: Integer, current corpus version. Bump on breaking layout changes.
format.vectors: Array of independent KDF derivations. Each entry is self-contained.
format.vectors[].name: Human-readable label for the case.
format.vectors[].roomSecret: Input: base64url-no-pad encoding of the 32-byte room secret (CSPRNG output).
format.vectors[].expected.roomId: base64url-no-pad of first 16 bytes of SHA-256("attn room v2" || roomSecret).
format.vectors[].expected.rootKey: base64url-no-pad of HKDF-SHA-256(IKM=roomSecret, salt=empty, info="attn room root v2", L=32).
format.vectors[].expected.eventKey: base64url-no-pad of HKDF-SHA-256(IKM=rootKey, salt=empty, info="attn event encryption v2", L=32).
format.vectors[].expected.snapshotKey: base64url-no-pad of HKDF-SHA-256(IKM=rootKey, salt=empty, info="attn snapshot encryption v2", L=32).
format.vectors[].expected.signalingKey: base64url-no-pad of HKDF-SHA-256(IKM=rootKey, salt=empty, info="attn signaling encryption v2", L=32).
format.vectors[].expected.admissionKey: base64url-no-pad of HKDF-SHA-256(IKM=rootKey, salt=empty, info="attn relay admission v2", L=32).
